limitations: The release is a regional volcanic-rock compilation, not nationwide or globally representative rock coverage.
It includes newly published analyses and records also available through NGD-Rock; DOI and original sample identifiers must participate in cross-platform duplicate detection.
The USGS Analytical Laboratories CSV contains 91 rows although the child-page summary says 90 samples; the adapter reports the file count and preserves this discrepancy.

The USGS Analytical Laboratories LATITUDE column contains west-longitude values and LONGITUDE contains north-latitude values. Both raw fields are retained and the explicit coordinate assignment note records the value-based swap.
Negative target values encode less-than limits. The adapter preserves the signed reported value and separately emits qualifier '<' and the positive censor limit.
Four UGS-ALS analytes can come from either ME-MS81 or ME-4ACD81 when both methods are listed; these 176 results retain both candidates instead of inventing a winning method.
No target Hg measurement occurs in the four child CSV files.
